lines.zh: 我伏在墙根，四肢一起挪。
lines.en: I creep along the wall on all fours.

lines.zh: 我经过时，尘土几乎不动。
lines.en: The dust barely stirs as I pass.

lines.zh: 我四肢反折，沿着墙根爬。
lines.en: I crawl along the wall base, my limbs bent backward.
Each inch I move, I pause.

lines.zh: 我从柱子后面绕到前面。
lines.en: I work my way from behind the pillar.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己，关节反着弯。
lines.en: I drag myself along, joints bending backwards.
There's water on the floor; I go around.
I crawl slowly over the threshold.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声几乎听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is nearly silent.
I keep to the shadows of the corridor.

lines.zh: 我停下来，听后面的动静。
lines.en: I stop and listen behind me.
I come closer, one step at a time.
I cling to the dark, motionless.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有第二个心跳。
lines.en: I listen for a second heartbeat.
My fingers trace the wall.
I wait for the light to go out.
I tilt my head and listen.
I've guarded this room a long time.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我背上，我不动。
lines.en: Dust settles on my back; I don't move.
I watch my own shadow.
Someone passes, so I draw back.
I'm counting the cracks in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这屋里还有个角落，我认得。
lines.en: There's a corner here I know.
I cling to the wall like a bulge.
My breathing stopped for half a minute.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，只是等着。
lines.en: I do nothing but wait.
I've been watching you a while.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是觉得有人？
lines.en: Did you feel someone just now?
I've been behind you all along.
Don't look back.
My eyes are bright in the dark.

lines.zh: 你数过这屋里有几个人吗。
lines.en: Have you counted how many are in this room?
I crawl faster than you walk.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯，让我眼睛疼。
lines.en: Your lamp hurts my eyes.
I crouch in the corner, silent.
There's sweat on your neck.

lines.zh: 你往前走一步，我就跟一步。
lines.en: You take a step; I take one too.
I don't care for bright places.
So you've seen me only now.
Don't pretend you didn't see me.
I've been behind the door a long time.
You still smell alive.

lines.zh: 我就在你影子的边角上。
lines.en: I'm at the edge of your shadow.
Your hand is reaching for a weapon.

lines.zh: 我缩进墙缝，把断口藏好。
lines.en: I shrink into the wall crack and hide the stump.
I withdraw into the wall; it hurts.
I drop and hit the floor.

lines.zh: 灰从我的关节里簌簌落下。
lines.en: Ash sifts down out of my joints.
I press to the floor and crawl slowly.
Your hits land surer than I thought.
My shadow has shrunk.

lines.zh: 伏从魔的呼吸没有声音。
lines.en: The Lurker's breath makes no sound.
I sink deeper into the wall.
I can still move. Don't celebrate.
That little light is too bright.
I wouldn't mind that coat.

lines.zh: 你身上有热，我一直缺这个。
lines.en: You carry warmth. I've lacked that.

lines.zh: 我爬到离你两步的地方。
lines.en: I crawl to within two paces.
Set the lamp down and I'll come out.
I extend a hand without touching.
I stop outside the threshold and wait.

lines.zh: 那点火光，我的手指伸过去又缩回。
lines.en: That little flame, my finger reaches out and pulls back.
That path leads behind you.
You've turned away. Good.
You bump me and feel something cold.
My limbs don't pull back in time.
I shrink into the gap and let you pass.
Your boot pins my fingers.

lines.zh: 我们把灰尘撞得满屋都是。
lines.en: We knock dust all over the room.
I retreat too quickly.
Don't push; the wall's behind me.
That knock cost me a piece.

lines.zh: 我的手指擦过你的膝盖，很凉。
lines.en: My fingers graze your knee, cold as stone.

lines.zh: 我们贴得很近，我几乎没声音。
lines.en: We're close, and I'm almost silent.
Another crouches across from me.
We look at each other, saying nothing.
It hugs the walls better than I.
We're divided by a single pillar.
It comes closer; so do I.
Neither of us makes a sound.
Its shadow lies inside mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这条走廊。
lines.en: Together we keep to this corridor.
It shares a piece with me.
In the dark, only the two of us.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，藏起来。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and hide it.
I take what's on the ground.
I stuff the cloth into my coat.
This iron scrap is somewhat useful.
I pick it up, then set it down.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面把东西扫过来。
lines.en: I sweep it toward me along the floor.
It's mine now. Don't make a sound.
I tuck it into the wall gap.

lines.zh: 有东西在发光，我按住它。
lines.en: Something glows; I cover it.
I look at it first, then pocket it.
You looked back. Too late.
I've crouched in this wall all along.
Your lamp is running low.
Your breathing changed; I heard it.
I come out of the wall.
You stepped on my fingers.

lines.zh: 这条走廊只有一头出口。
lines.en: This corridor has one way out.

lines.zh: 墙缝里我的手指先探出来。
lines.en: My fingers come out of the crack first.
We're not rushed. I'm very patient.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶的梁上，垂着。
lines.en: I hang from the beam above your head.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯灭了，我离你更近。
lines.en: The corridor lamp dies, and I am closer.
I've closed your way back.
The Lurker can smell your fear.
I crouch in the dark and wait for you to come close.
It's too dark; you can't aim.

lines.zh: 地板下面有指甲刮过的声音。
lines.en: Something scrapes beneath the floorboards.

lines.zh: 我盯着你那只握东西的手。
lines.en: I watch the hand that holds your tool.
You take a step; I crawl one.
I'm in your shadow. It's comfortable.
The lamp can't reach this corner.
I'm waiting for you to cross the threshold.
You've had your back to me too long.
My fingers dig into the brick seam.
I make no sound, and you can't hear.
There's a dead end ahead. I know.
Before you count to three, I'll be there.
I'm on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 你那半拍乱，我听出来了。
lines.en: That half-beat stumble. I heard it.
One more turn and it's the last.
I don't need to see you clearly.
This darkness has always been mine.

lines.zh: 我听你喘气就知道距离。
lines.en: I know the distance from your breathing.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，墙就跟到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you go, the walls follow.

lines.zh: 我从一开始就没离开过这里。
lines.en: I never left this place at all.
I drop from above.
My fingers hook your shoulder.
I bite into your arm.
You throw me off and hit the wall.

lines.zh: 这一下抓到了你的后背。
lines.en: This one rakes your back.
You pull back; I crawl after.
I pin you against the doorframe.
My nails are longer than you thought.

lines.zh: 你跌坐在地，我就在旁边。
lines.en: You fall sitting, and I'm right there.
A light touch; I didn't use force.

lines.zh: 我用反折的关节按住你的手腕。
lines.en: My bent-back joints pin your wrist.

lines.zh: 我从墙里伸出手，扣住你的腰。
lines.en: I reach out of the wall and hook your waist.
I drag you down.
I breathe at your ear.
I haul you toward the corner.
You've finally gone quiet.
A new shadow joins the wall.
I squeeze out of the brick seam.

lines.zh: 天花板上有东西掉下来。
lines.en: Something drops from the ceiling.
The count of people in this room is wrong.
I straighten up slowly.
The dust moves on its own.
The instant the lamp dies, I arrive.
There's breathing in the corner.
I grow out of the darkness.
The floorboards creak once.

lines.zh: 我贴在天花板上一动不动。
lines.en: I cling to the ceiling, motionless.
Someone hears something behind them.
I climb up through the floor.
The shadows here have thickened.
I show my fingers first.

lines.zh: 我没发出声音，可我在了。
lines.en: I made no sound, but I'm here.

lines.zh: 门缝里挤进来一点什么。
lines.en: Something squeezes through the door gap.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，就在你身后。
lines.en: I rise slowly, right behind you.
The fire's light makes me shrink all over.

lines.zh: 我从天花板摔下，四肢散了。
lines.en: I fall from the ceiling and my limbs sprawl.
Water floods in and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从墙上撕下来。
lines.en: The blast peels me off the wall.

lines.zh: 一枚箭把我钉在门框上。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the doorframe.

lines.zh: 法术的光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The spell's light blinds me.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到东西，我虚了。
lines.en: Too long without feeding; I'm weak.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: A flash of lightning locks my whole body.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从影子里扯走。
lines.en: The void pulls me out of the shadow.
